# Fieldbook OS

> An agentic OS you set up with one prompt: memory, work items, projects, messaging, backups, scheduled jobs and a dashboard for any file-capable AI assistant. Plain files and standard-library Python.

To install for a user, read INSTALL.md and follow it from the top.

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): the installing AI's instructions, interview included
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, supported platforms, security note
- [workspace/AGENTS.md](workspace/AGENTS.md): the rules every session in an installed workspace reads
- [workspace/Skills/00_triggers.md](workspace/Skills/00_triggers.md): named jobs and the procedure for each
